description: This file serves as an initializer for the litellm_completion_bridge package, providing module-level documentation and exposing key functions and classes related to the A2A to LiteLLM completion bridge. It imports specific handlers and transformation classes from submodules and defines the symbols to be publicly accessible.

classes.name: A2ACompletionBridgeHandler
classes.description: Handler class for managing A2A protocol completion requests, encapsulating logic to interface with LiteLLM APIs.

methods.name: handle_a2a_completion
methods.description: Function to process A2A completion requests in a standard manner.

methods.name: handle_a2a_completion_streaming
methods.description: Function to process streaming A2A completion requests.

methods.name: A2ACompletionBridgeTransformation
methods.description: Class responsible for transforming messages between the A2A protocol and LiteLLM API.
